items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I never -- see, he was a little before my time. He started in the '20s... And it was just a rare treat to go -- the people used to go... to hear that band.

ctx.x: They had a lot of black theatres.
Well, there was only a few of them that had music. The Vendome with Erskine Tate, and --
